title: Rate-Setting Worksheet: SecureRate Default Renewal Rate, Deferred Fixed Annuities
content:
Worksheet for the default renewal rate of an Ashgrove SecureRate contract (Deferred Fixed Annuities) renewing by default into a new guarantee period.

## Formal statement

1. **Renewal value.** The default renewal rate is worked out from the renewal value, which is the contract value at the most recent interest credit grown at the expiring guaranteed rate, as a daily equivalent of that annual effective rate, for the actual calendar days from that credit to the renewal date, rounded to the cent — that is, the contract value times one plus the expiring rate raised to the power of the days over 365.
2. **Rate.** The default renewal rate is the tier's current base rate plus the tier's high band rate addition where the renewal value is at least the tier's high band threshold, and the current base rate alone otherwise, never below the tier's guaranteed minimum interest rate, rounded to four decimal places.

## Inputs

| Input | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| Contract value at the most recent interest credit | The activity history as it stands: premiums received plus interest credited, less withdrawals, surrender charges and death benefit payments |
| Date of the most recent interest credit | The latest interest credit entry |
| Renewal date | The day after the guarantee period end date on the contract record |
| Expiring guaranteed rate | The guaranteed rate on the contract record for the period that is ending |
| Current base rate, high band rate addition, high band threshold, guaranteed minimum interest rate | The tier's figures in the declared rate schedule |

## Worked figure (hypothetical Ashgrove SecureRate 5)

Contract value at the most recent interest credit (10 January 2026) $120000.00; expiring guaranteed rate 4.50%; guarantee period end date 31 March 2026, so the renewal date is 1 April 2026.

| Step | Figure |
|---|---|
| Days from 10 January to 1 April | 81 |
| Renewal value: $120000.00 times 1.045 raised to the power of 81 over 365, rounded | $121177.92 |
| At least the high band threshold of the tier? | Yes |
| Current base rate plus high band rate addition | 5.10% plus 0.15%, that is 5.25% |
| Not below the guaranteed minimum; rounded to four places | 0.0525 |

With a renewal value of $95000.00 instead, the rate would be the current base rate alone, 0.0510.
